name: Optical & Photonic Materials
summary: Explains how light interacts with materials and the materials used for lenses, fibres, lasers, LEDs, displays and optical coatings.

topics.name: Electromagnetic radiation and its interaction with solids
Refraction, reflection, absorption and transmission; the complex refractive index
Colour in metals, semiconductors, insulators and pigments
Dispersion and the Lorentz and Drude models of optical response
Semiconductor emitters and detectors: LEDs, laser diodes, photodiodes
Laser materials: gain media, Nd:YAG, fibre and solid-state lasers
Optical fibres: glass purity, attenuation, dispersion and doped-fibre amplifiers
Optical and anti-reflection coatings; thin-film interference
Electro-optic, acousto-optic and nonlinear optical materials
Infrared and optical window materials for sensors and spacecraft
